comment: MSGTYPE=stop "Entering\sthe\stutorial" on the tutorial pre-message. glibc reads \s as a space class and stops there, so the level change waits for the key; macOS TRE without REG_ENHANCED reads it as a literal s, matches nothing and the level change happens first.
